import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def objs(I):
    cs=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(len(I)):
        for c in range(len(I[0])):
            if I[r][c]: cs[I[r][c]].append((r,c))
    return {k:(min(x for x,_ in v),min(y for _,y in v),max(x for x,_ in v),max(y for _,y in v),len(v)) for k,v in cs.items()}
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=G[p+' input']; O=G[p+' output']
    ob=objs(I); rin=objs(O)
    colors=sorted(ob,key=lambda kk:-ob[kk][4])
    # ring color = fewer cells? demo1 ring 5 (12 cells) vs 4(44) -> ring is inner color. ring = color of smaller bbox? inner color has smaller count.
    inner_color=min(colors,key=lambda kk:ob[kk][4])
    outer_color=[c for c in colors if c!=inner_color][0]
    # verify output ring color = inner_color, kept shape color = outer_color
    ok_all = True
    for (cr,r0,c0,r1,c1,n) in rin.items():
        pass
    # find ring bbox in O: the largest bbox
    ring=max(rin,key=lambda kk:rin[kk][2]-rin[kk][0]+rin[kk][3]-rin[kk][1])
    sb=ob[outer_color]; ib=ob[inner_color]
    print(p,'grid',(len(I),len(I[0])))
    print('  shapes:',[(k,bb) for k,bb in ob.items()],'ringcolor',ring[0],'ringbbox',rin[ring])
    print('  innerbbox',ib)
    r0r,r1r,c0r,c1r=rin[ring]
    # ring offsets relative to shape center
    sr=(r0+r1)/2; sc=(c0+c1)/2
    print('  shape center',(sr,sc),' ring center',( (r0r+r1r)/2,(c0r+c1r)/2),' shift',(r0r-sr,c0r-sc))

G=load()
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    I=G[p+' input']; O=G[p+' output']
    cs=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(len(I)):
        for c in range(len(I[0])):
            if I[r][c]: cs[I[r][c]].append((r,c))
    items=sorted(cs.items(), key=lambda kv: len(kv[1]))
    ic, fc = items[0][0], items[1][0]
    ib=bb(cs[ic]); ob=bb(cs[fc])
    ch=[(r,c) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
    # output structure: ring bbox, frame bbox in output, core bbox
    oc=collections.Counter(O[r][c] for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(len(O)) for c in range(len(O[0])) if O[r][c] not in (0,)])
    print(p,'I colors',[(c,len(v),bb(v)) for c,v in cs.items()], 'O nonzero counts', dict(oc))
    print('  inner_in ',ib,'outer_in ',ob, '| changed cells:',len(ch))

steps.input:
G=load()
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    I=G[p+' input']; O=G[p+' output']
    cs=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(len(I)):
        for c in range(len(I[0])):
            if I[r][c]: cs[I[r][c]].append((r,c))
    order=sorted(cs.items(), key=lambda kv: len(kv[1]))
    ic,fc=order[0][0],order[1][0]
    ir=[min(x[0] for x in order[0][1]),max(x[0] for x in order[0][1]),min(x[1] for x in order[0][1]),max(x[1] for x in order[0][1])]
    fr=[min(x[0] for x in order[1][1]),max(x[0] for x in order[1][1]),min(x[1] for x in order[1][1]),max(x[1] for x in order[1][1])]
    ch=[(r,c) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
    rr=[min(x[0] for x in ch),max(x[0] for x in ch),min(x[1] for x in ch),max(x[1] for x in ch)]
    print(p,'IC',ir,'FC',fr,'RING(changed)',rr,'grid',(len(I),len(I[0])))

def solve(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    cs=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]: cs[I[r][c]].append((r,c))
    order=[k for k,_ in sorted(cs.items(), key=lambda kv:len(kv[1]))]
    ic=fcol=0
    ic_=order[0]; fc_=order[1]
    ib=bb(cs[ic_]); fb=bb(cs[fc_])
    ih=ib[2]-ib[0]+1; iw=ib[3]-ib[1]+1
    e = ih if ih==iw else (ih+iw-max(ih,iw)//0+ (min(ih,iw)+1)//2) if False else ((min(ih,iw)+1)//2) if ih!=iw else ih
    # e = side if square else ceil(min/2)
    e = ih if ih==iw else (min(ih,iw)+1)//2
    r0=ib[0]-e; r1=ib[2]+e; c0=ib[1]-e; c1=ib[3]+e
    O=[[I[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def bbox_of(g,v):
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]==v]
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    return min(rs),min(cs),max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1
for n in range(1,6):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    vals=sorted(set(x for r in I for x in r))
    colors=[v for v in vals if v!=0]
    print('demo',n,'grid',H,W,'colors',[ (v,bbox_of(I,v),bbox_of(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'],v)) for v in colors ])

def solve(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    # objects: colors by count; find solid vs frame via shape: color with rectangular solid fill vs ring
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    def bbox(g,v):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]==v]
        rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
        return min(rs),min(cs),max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    objs=[]
    for v in cnt:
        if v==0: continue
        r0,c0,h,w=bbox(I,v)
        solid = h*w == cnt[v]
        objs.append((v,r0,c0,h,w,solid))
    # inner = smaller solid block; outer = frame (hollow rectangle, bbox area > cells)
    inner=[o for o in objs if o[5]]
    outer=[o for o in objs if not o[5]]
    assert len(inner)==len(outer)==1, (objs)
    ic,ir,iw,ih=inner[0][1],inner[0][2],inner[0][3],inner[0][4]
    oc,ocr,oh,ow=outer[0][1],outer[0][2],outer[0][3],outer[0][4]
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    ring_h = oh+2*ih; ring_w = ow+2*iw
    cr = (oc+ocr-1)/2.0; cc = (ic+iw-1)/2.0  # inner center
    # place ring border: rows cr-rh//2.. ; use float center -> clip bounds
    t_ = int(round(cr-ring_h/2)); b_=int(round(cr+ring_h/2))
    l_ = int(round(cc-ring_w/2)); r_=int(round(cc+ring_w/2))
    for r in range(t_,b_+1):
        for c in range(l_,r_+1):
            if (r==t_ or r==b_ or c==l_ or c==r_) and (not (ir<=r<iw and iw<=c<iw)):  # placeholder, fix below
                pass
    # rebuild cleanly: ring cells = border of [t_,b_]x[l_,r_]
    for r in range(t_,b_+1):
        for c in range(l_,r_+1):
            on_border = (r==t_ or r==b_ or c==l_ or c==r_)
            if on_border and not (t_<=r<=b_ and l_<=c<=r_ and False):
                out[r][c]=inner[0][0]
    return out
ok=True
for n in range(1,6):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    r=solve(I)
    ok &= r==O
    if r!=O:
        print('MISMATCH demo',n)
        for rr in range(min(len(I),len(O))):
            a=''.join(map(str,r[rr])); b=''.join(map(str,O[rr]))
            if a!=b: print(rr,a,'|',b); break
print('all ok' if ok else 'fail')

def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter as C
    cnt=C(x for r in g for x in r)
    def bbox(v):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs_=[p[1] for p in cells]
        return min(rs),min(cs_),max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs_)-min(cs_)+1,len(cells)
    items=[(v,bbox(v)) for v in cnt if v!=0]
    inner=min(items,key=lambda t:t[1][4]); outer=min([t for t in items if t is not inner],key=lambda t:t[1][4])
    ih,iw=inner[1][2],inner[1][3]; iv=inner[0]
    oh,ow=outer[1][2],outer[1][3]
    cr=(inner[1][0]+ih-1)/2; cc=(inner[1][1]+iw-1)/2
    sh=oh+2*ih; sw=ow+2*iw
    top=int(round(cr-sh/2)); bot=top+sh-1
    left=int(round(cc-sw/2)); right=left+sw-1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(max(top,0),min(bot,H-1)+1):
        for c in range(max(left,0),min(right,W-1)+1):
            if r==max(top,0) or r==min(bot,H-1) or c==max(left,0) or c==min(right,W-1):
                out[r][c]=iv
    return out
print('check', all(solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'] for n in range(1,6)))

def solve(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    cs=comps_of(I)
    big=max(cs,key=lambda o:len(o[1])); inc=min(cs,key=lambda o:len(o[1]))
    colb,cin=big[0],inc[0]
    fr=bbox(inc); r0,r1,c0,c1=fr[0],fr[1],fr[2],fr[3]  # bbox of largest comp is frame; inner bbox computed later
    ib=[a for a in range(h) for b in range(w) if I[a][b]==cin]
    ir0,ir1,iw0,iw1=min(a for a,b in ib),max(a for a,b in ib),min(b for a,b in ib),max(b for a,b in ib)
    O=[[x for x in row] for row in I]
    for a in range(r0-1,min(r1+2,h)):
        for b in range(c0-1,min(c1+2,w)):
            if (a==r0-1 or a==r1+1 or b==c0-1 or b==c1+1) and I[a][b]==0: O[a][b]=cin
    return O

def solve(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    cs=comps_of(I)
    big=max(cs,key=lambda o:len(o[1])); inc=min(cs,key=lambda o:len(o[1]))
    fb=bbox(big[1]); ib=bbox(inc[1])
    p=max(ib[0]-fb[0], fb[1]-ib[1], ib[2]-fb[2], fb[3]-ib[3])  # padding of inner in frame
    ih,iw=ib[1]-ib[0]+1, ib[3]-ib[2]+1
    mf = p + max(ih-2, iw-2, 0) if ih==iw else p
    O=[list(r) for r in I]
    for a in range(fb[0]-mf-1, fb[1]+mf+2):
        for b in range(fb[2]-mf-1, fb[3]+mf+2):
            if (a in (fb[0]-mf-1, fb[1]+mf+1) or b in (fb[2]-mf-1, fb[3]+mf+1)) and I[a][b]==0:
                O[a][b]=inc[0]
    return O

def info(n):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; T=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    cs=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    counts={c:sum(1 for r in I for x in r if x==c) for c in cs}
    fr=max(counts,key=lambda c:counts[c]); ir=[c for c in cs if c!=fr][0]
    F=bbox([(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==fr])
    Inn=bbox([(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==ir])
    R=bbox([(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if T[r][c]==ir and I[r][c]==bg])
    return dict(n=n,h=h,w=w,bg=bg,fr=fr,ir=ir,F=F,Inn=Inn,R=R)
for n in range(1,6):
    x=info(n)
    print(x['n'],'grid',x['h'],x['w'],'F',x['F'],'Inn',x['Inn'],'R',x['R'])
    # vertical span of figure: min/max row of non-bg
    span=(min(r for r in [(r,c) for r in range(x['h']) for c in range(x['w']) if x['I'][r][c]!=x['bg']])) if False else None

def f(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    cs=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    counts={c:sum(1 for r in I for x in r if x==c) for c in cs}
    fr=max(counts,key=lambda c:counts[c]); ir=[c for c in cs if c!=fr][0]
    F=bbox([(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==fr])
    Inn=bbox([(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==ir])
    pad=min(Inn[1]-Inn[0],Inn[3]-Inn[2])-abs(F[1]-F[0])
    lo,hi=F[0]-pad,F[1]+pad; lo2,hi2=F[2]-pad,F[3]+pad
    O=[list(r) for r in I]
    for a in range(lo,hi+1):
        for b in range(lo2,hi2+1):
            if (a in (lo,hi) or b in (lo2,hi2)) and 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and I[a][b]==bg:
                O[a][b]=ir
    return O

def comps(I,bg):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                stack=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); comp.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and I[ny][nx]!=bg and (ny,nx) not in comp:

                seen|=comp; out.append(comp)

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    best=None
    for comp in comps(I,bg):
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        if best is None or len(comp)<len(best[1]): best=(None,comp)
        else: best=(comp,len(comp))
    _,comp=best
    rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    cnt_=Counter(I[y][x] for y,x in comp)
    fill=[c for c,n_ in cnt_.items() if n_<max(cnt_.values())][0]
    fh=r1-r0+1-2*0  # fill bbox height computed below
    frset={(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1) if I[y][x]!=fill}
    fcells=[(y,x) for y,x in comp if I[y][x]==fill]
    fbb=bbox_of(fcells); fhh=fbb[1]-fbb[0]+1
    k = fhh-2 if fhh>=4 else fhh
    O=[list(r) for r in I]
    for y in range(r0-k,r1+k+1):
        for x in range(c0-k,c1+k+1):
            if I[y][x]==bg: O[y][x]=fill
    return O
print(all(solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'] for n in range(1,6)))
out=solve(G['Test input'])

steps.input:
def pat(I,O):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if I[y][x] not in (bg,)]
    cnt_=Counter(I[y][x] for y,x in pts)
    frc=max(cnt_,key=cnt_.get); fc=[c for c in cnt_ if c!=frc][0]
    F=(min(y for y,_ in pts),max(y for y,_ in pts),min(x for _,x in pts),max(x for _,x in pts))
    return F,frc,fc
def show(n):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    F,frc,fc=pat(I,O)
    print('=== demo',n,'fg',F,'colors frame=',frc,'fill=',fc)
    for y in range(F[0]-2,F[1]+3):
        si=''.join(str(I[y][x]) if I[y][x] else '.' for x in range(len(I[0])))
        so=''.join(str(O[y][x]) if O[y][x] else '.' for x in range(len(O[0])))
        print(si,so)
show(1);show(2);show(3)

data=[]
for n in range(1,6):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if I[y][x] not in (bg,)]
    cnt_=Counter(I[y][x] for y,x in pts)
    frc=max(cnt_,key=cnt_.get); fc=[c for c in cnt_ if c!=frc][0]
    F=(min(y for y,_ in pts),max(y for y,_ in pts),min(x for _,x in pts),max(x for _,x in pts))
    PtsO=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if O[y][x]==fc]
    R=(min(y for y,_ in PtsO),max(y for y,_ in PtsO),min(x for _,x in PtsO),max(x for _,x in PtsO))
    fh=R[0]-F[0]; fw=R[1]-F[1]; ft=R[2]-F[2]; fb=R[3]-F[3]
    fg_h=F[1]-F[0]+1; fg_w=F[3]-F[2]+1
    fh_=F[1]-F[0]+1-2*(F[1]-F[0]+1-F[0])*0  # fill bbox
    fp=[(y,x) for y,x in pts if I[y][x]==fc]
    fb_=min(y for y,_ in fp); fe_=max(y for y,_ in fp); fbw_=min(x for _,x in fp); febw_=max(x for _,x in fp)
    data.append(dict(n=n,fg_h=fg_h,fg_w=fg_w,fill_h=fe_-fb_+1,fill_w=febw_-fbw_+1,t=max(fh,fw,ft,fb)))
for d in data: print(d)

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if I[y][x]!=bg]
    cnt_=Counter(I[y][x] for y,x in pts)
    frc=max(cnt_,key=cnt_.get); fc=[c for c in cnt_ if c!=frc][0]
    F=(min(y for y,_ in pts),max(y for y,_ in pts),min(x for _,x in pts),max(x for _,x in pts))
    fp=[p for p in pts if I[p[0]][p[1]]==fc]
    fb=(min(y for y,_ in fp),max(y for y,_ in fp),min(x for _,x in fp),max(x for _,x in fp))
    fh,fbw=fb[1]-fb[0]+1,fb[3]-fb[2]+1
    t=min(fb[1]-fb[0]+1,fb[3]-fb[2]+1)-(1 if fh!=fbw else 0)
    O=[list(r) for r in I]
    for y in range(F[0]-t,F[1]+t+1):
        for x in range(F[2]-t,F[3]+t+1):
            if O[y][x]==bg: O[y][x]=fc
    return O
print(all(f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'] for n in range(1,6)))

def f(I,t=None):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if I[y][x]!=bg]
    cc=Counter(I[y][x] for y,x in pts); frame=max(cc,key=lambda c:cc[c]); fill=[c for c in cc if c!=frame][0]
    y0=min(y for y,_ in pts); y1=max(y for y,_ in pts); x0=min(x for _,x in pts); x1=max(x for _,x in pts)
    oh=y1-y0+1; ow=x1-x0+1
    if t is None:
        s=max(oh,ow)
        t=s if s==min(oh,ow) else min(oh,ow)-1
    O=[list(r) for r in I]
    for y in range(y0-t,y1+t+1):
        for x in range(x0-t,x1+t+1):
            if 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W and O[y][x]==bg: O[y][x]=fill
    return O

G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in range(1,6):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if I[y][x]!=bg]
    cc=Counter(I[y][x] for y,x in pts); frame=max(cc,key=lambda c:cc[c]); fill=[c for c in cc if c!=frame][0]
    fp=[(y,x) for y,x in pts if I[y][x]==fill]
    ys=[y for y,_ in fp]; xs=[x for _,x in fp]
    fb=(min(y for y,_ in pts),max(y for y,_ in pts),min(x for _,x in pts),max(x for _,x in pts))
    oys=[y for y in range(H) if any(O[y][x]!=I[y][x] for x in range(W))]
    oxs=[x for x in range(W) if any(O[y][x]!=I[y][x] for y in range(H))]
    changed=[[O[y][x] for x in range(W)] for y in range(H) if any(O[y][x]!=I[y][x] for x in range(W))]
    chg=[y for y,row in enumerate(changed) if any(row)]
    print(n,'H,W',H,W,'fgbbox',fb,'fill color',fill,'fill shape',(len(set(fp)),set(xs)), 'filled color(s) in out:',sorted({O[y][x] for y in range(H) for x in range(W)}),'changed rows',chg,'cols',oxs)

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if I[y][x]!=bg]
    cc=Counter(I[y][x] for y,x in pts)
    # frame = most frequent fg color; fill = other
    frame=max(cc,key=lambda c:cc[c]); fill=[c for c in cc if c!=frame][0]
    fb=(min(y for y,_ in pts),max(y for y,_ in pts),min(x for _,x in pts),max(x for _,x in pts))
    fp=[(y,x) for y,x in pts if I[y][x]==fill]
    ys=[y for y,_ in fp]; xs=[x for _,x in fp]
    th=min(max(ys)-min(ys)+1, max(xs)-min(xs)+1)
    if len(set(ys))==1 or len(set(xs))==1: th-=1  # non-square -> side-1
    O=[list(r) for r in I]
    for y in range(fb[0]-th,fb[1]+th+1):
        for x in range(fb[2]-th,fb[3]+th+1):
            if 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W and O[y][x]==bg: O[y][x]=fill
    return O
for n in range(1,6):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']; R=solve(I)
    print(n, R==O)
